profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: UC Irvine Alumni hailing from Moreno Valley, CA. Currently a software engineer for Communities within support.google.com. Some of my interests include full-stack web development, graphic design, and just technology in general. I enjoy working on all aspects of the software I develop from the UI to the database schema. In addition to technical skills, I have a background in graphic design and in communications/marketing. A few of the projects that illustrate can be found on my profile below.

projects.title: Sleeptracker
projects.description: Began as a course project with a classmate, and eventually turned into what it is today after some weeks of work after the course's conclusion. A few of Sleeptracker's features include CRUD operations on sleep data stored in a Firestore instance. The project was built using Ionic and is hosted on Firebase. Sleeptracker uses Firebase authentication and only supports one account for demonstration purposes only. Direct message me if you're interested in trying it out.

projects.title: Spoofy
projects.description: It started as a course project with a classmate, and eventually turned into what it is today after some weeks of work after the course's conclusion. The project was meant to be a demonstration of some of the capabilities of the Spotify Developer API. Some of Spoofy's features include viewing you personal library of songs, artists, albums, and playlists and browsing Spotify's vast library of content. The project was built using Angular 8 and Express and is hosted on Heroku and Firebase. To use the application, you must log into your Spotify account through the 'Login' button provided in the Navbar.
